wheat.high_risk: Terminal heat stress or extreme deficit detected. Prioritize afternoon cooling irrigation and zinc/potassium foliar spray.
wheat.medium_risk: Moderate deficit. Optimize final canal turn 10-14 days prior to harvest.

maize.high_risk: Severe moisture stress or waterlogging. Check field drainage and irrigate silking canopy.
maize.medium_risk: Moderate stress. Maintain consistent soil moisture during grain filling.
maize.low_risk: Optimal conditions. Scout for Fall Armyworm and maintain fertilizer schedule.
